name: proctor
description: Hook-enforced development discipline for Claude Code. Skills teach methodology; hooks enforce compliance mechanically (git gates, planning mode, step budgets, quiet mode, pre-flight checks, self-diagnosis, autonomy metrics); store + tracing survive compaction.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Branch names protected from destructive git operations (commit, push, merge, rebase, reset)

executableDocPatterns.title: Executable doc patterns
executableDocPatterns.description: Globs for prose-shaped files that are really behaviour (runbooks a tool runs, agent instructions, fixtures). The commit gate keeps enforcing on these instead of treating them as inert prose.

testFreshnessMinutes.title: Test freshness (minutes)
testFreshnessMinutes.description: How many minutes before test evidence expires and the git gate blocks commits

watchdogTurnThreshold.title: Skill watchdog threshold
watchdogTurnThreshold.description: Number of consecutive turns without a skill invocation before the watchdog fires a reminder

fixRoundCap.title: Fix-round cap
fixRoundCap.description: Maximum fix-loop rounds in SDD before the hook forces adjudication instead of another dispatch

stepBudgetPerTask.title: Step budget per task
stepBudgetPerTask.description: Maximum tool calls allowed per SDD task before forcing adjudication. Warns at 80%, blocks at 100%.

timeBudgetPerTaskMinutes.title: Time budget per task (minutes)
timeBudgetPerTaskMinutes.description: Wall-clock time limit per SDD task before forcing adjudication. Warns at 80%, blocks at 100%.
